title: Unique Text Subsequences
summary: Return every distinct subsequence, including the empty string.
statement: Return every distinct subsequence, including the empty string. Implement `unique_text_subsequences` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Every character creates include and exclude recursive branches.
Recurse on the next index twice and deduplicate completed strings.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the unique_text_subsequences invariant is complete.
Editorial: Recurse on the next index twice and deduplicate completed strings. The intended bounds are O(2ⁿ) time and O(2ⁿ) space.
